case: a directory stands where the file belongs (built in the spec; {systemError} is the OS message)
sentence: the file could not be read: Error: {systemError}

case: the bytes are not UTF-8 text (built in the spec)
sentence: the file is not UTF-8 text

case: the first line is not the frontmatter fence
sentence: the first line must be the frontmatter fence `---`

case: the frontmatter has no closing fence
sentence: the frontmatter has no closing `---` fence

case: a line that is not key: value
stored:

slot: 1
just prose

Body.

case: the key is not an epic key
